meta.paperTitle: Dynamics creation through neural dynamical transfer learning
meta.authors: He Ma, Qiyang Ge, Yu Meng, Celso Grebogi, and Wei Lin

hp.title: Creating oscillatory ecological coexistence
hp.summary: A stable food chain and a chaotic food chain yield a projected HP model with persistent, periodic coexistence of resource, herbivore, and carnivore.
hp.qualification: The ecological conclusion concerns the projection into the HP model family. The raw optimized tensor has different persistence and oscillation outcomes.

seirs.title: Interpretable epidemiological models
seirs.summary: SEIRS content and Lorenz style produce sparse equations with additional exposed-compartment inflow and nonlinear infection terms, within a range of feature weights.
seirs.qualification: β/γ measures the fitted transmission–recovery balance; it is not the overall basic reproduction number of the new equations. Very low content/style ratios can lose the original SEIRS characteristics.
seirs.dataAvailability: Published image and saved experiment configurations are available locally. Numerical field sweeps are listed in the companion manifest but are not present in this code preview; no synthetic trajectory is substituted.
provenance: Published Fig. 8 and Section V B

encryption.title: Generated chaos as an algorithmic source
encryption.summary: A Lorenz-content/Chen-style system drives a permutation–diffusion pipeline, producing noise-like ciphertext and exact recovery with the correct key in the published demonstration.
encryption.qualification: This is the published downstream demonstration and benchmark, not a claim of comprehensive cryptographic security or uniform superiority on every metric.

featureAnalysis.contentSummary: Spatially resolved activation tensors retain local or aggregated vector-field structure, depending on encoder depth.
featureAnalysis.styleSummary: Gram matrices summarize second-order feature-channel correlations while contracting the spatial index.
featureAnalysis.qualification: Input-layer time reversal and aligned coordinate exchange preserve Gram features. Reflection and rotation are only comparatively stable in the tested systems; there is no universal rotation invariance or general energy interpretation.
